title: PluginToolbox Plugin Manifest Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for PluginToolbox plugin.json manifest file

id.description: Unique identifier for the plugin (3-50 lowercase letters, digits, and underscores)

name.description: Human-readable display name of the plugin

description.description: Short summary of what this plugin does

author.description: Author or maintainer of the plugin

minAppVersion.description: Minimum PluginToolbox host version required to run this plugin

type.description: Scripting engine type (currently lua is supported)

category.description: Category under which the plugin is classified

permissions.description: Required capability permissions declared by the plugin

entry.description: Relative path to main Lua entry script (e.g. main.lua)

ui.description: Relative path to declarative UI definition JSON file (e.g. ui/main.ui.json)

icon.description: Relative path to plugin icon image (recommended 128x128 PNG)

storageQuotaMb.description: Maximum sandbox storage quota in megabytes allocated to this plugin
